items.title: John Paulson says we are in the early stages of a long-term bull market for gold
items.summary: John Paulson, the hedge fund manager who made billions betting against the U.S. housing market before turning bullish on gold, said he believes the precious metal is only in the early stages of a long-term rally.

items.title: Kalshi launches election hub for prediction markets ahead of midterms
items.summary: Prediction market platform Kalshi on Wednesday launched a new hub that allows political junkies to see how traders in many event contracts think the midterm elections will play out.

items.title: Kevin Warsh has homed in on three key phrases. How Fed watchers interpret them
items.summary: He's not quite at the level of obscurity of former Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan, but new Fed chief Kevin Warsh has settled on a few phrases that are notable for their repetition and lack of clarity.

items.title: ‘It would feel like a burden’: My stepmother, 96, owns the house I grew up in. Is it wrong to tell her I don’t want to inherit it?
items.summary: Is it appropriate to tell someone you don’t want an inheritance? My stepmother is 96 and owns the house I grew up in, in another town.

items.title: The late James Van Der Beek’s former Beverly Hills home up for rent for $13,950 a month
items.summary: Late “Dawson’s Creek” star James Van Der Beek’s former Beverly Hills home has been offered up for rent—five months after the actor died following a battle with cancer.

items.title: I will definitely claim Social Security early. Why do so few people talk about the elephant in the room?
items.summary: I read your response to the letter about the man who passed away after receiving only one Social Security check (“ ‘It’s heartbreaking’: My brother claimed Social Security at 70.

items.title: Texas Instruments shares are sliding, and its rival is doing even worse. What’s going on in the world of analog semiconductors.
items.summary: Texas Instruments shares were falling while STMicroelectronics stock was diving on Thursday, after both makers of analog semiconductors struggled to meet heightened expectations after reporting strong demand in the second quarter.

items.title: The bull market faces higher likelihood of a Fed rate hike as Iran crisis intensifies
items.summary: The bull case for stocks suddenly looks more fragile as the Iran war intensifies, oil prices rise and anxiety builds in the U.S. bond market about possible Federal Reserve rate hikes.

items.title: ServiceNow’s stock rises as earnings show momentum in cybersecurity
items.summary: Against a gloomy backdrop for software sentiment, ServiceNow just topped revenue expectations.

items.title: IBM just cut its outlook, but not by as much as investors feared
items.summary: International Business Machines warned last week that its quarterly revenue had come up short as customers drained their budgets on artificial-intelligence hardware, leaving less room to invest in software.
